BASS, BASSmix, BASSenc, BASSFLAC, BASSOPUS, BASSALAC and BASSenc_MP3
are distributed under the terms in the accompanying license files.

BASSenc_MP3 uses libmp3lame under the GNU LGPL version 2.
The corresponding BASSenc_MP3 source is available from:
https://www.un4seen.com/files/bassenc_mp3-source.zip

An end user may replace BASSenc_MP3 with a compatible modified build.
For a frozen Windows build, place bassenc_mp3.dll beside the executable.
For a frozen Linux build, place libbassenc_mp3.so beside the executable.
